_comment: Full example config — copy to config.json and fill in your values. Lines starting with _ are notes and can be removed.
_slack_webhook_note: Create a webhook at https://api.slack.com/apps — see SLACK_SETUP.md for instructions
_check_interval_note: Seconds between ping cycles. 300 = 5 minutes. Also keeps IPsec/Twingate tunnels alive.
_report_interval_note: Seconds between full health summary reports to Slack. 3600 = 1 hour.

sites.name: Site Name Here
sites._name_note: Human-readable label shown in Slack alerts and reports
sites._addresses_note: Replace 0.0.0.0 with the real IP(s) to monitor — Twingate connector host, tunnel endpoint, or any LAN host
sites._test_ports_note: Optional TCP port checks. 4242=DICOM, 8201-8203=HL7 Mirth. Remove test_ports entirely to use ping-only monitoring.
